press_references.value: ED seizes business jet at Hyderabad airport in money laundering case

legal_proceedings.description: The Enforcement Directorate seized a business jet at Hyderabad airport as part of a money laundering investigation against Falcon Group and its promoters, including CMD Amar Deep Kumar. The case involves a Rs 850 crore Ponzi scheme, with Rs 1,700 crore collected from investors. The jet, owned by Prestige Jets Inc, was allegedly bought with proceeds from the scheme.
